difficulty curve added (user asked whether opponents progress; they were flat-random). Before: tier stats (J20/10,Q30/15,K40/20) + King enrage escalated, but Royal Decrees were assigned UNIFORMLY at random regardless of tier. Now decrees are TIERED by severity (content.DECREE_SEVERITY): Jacks draw a MILD decree (Iron Wall / Vampire / new Thick Hide -2 dmg), Queens a STANDARD decree (Headsman / Paranoid Crown / Plague Court), Kings a SEVERE decree (Executioner / new The Tyrant = ignores-shield + drain) PLUS a stacked MILD decree, and the FINAL King gets the new FINISHER 'The Mad King' (ignores shield + lops a card each attack + 1.25x HP) plus a stacked severe. Enemy gained decreeId2 (clone-safe); combat.enemyDecrees() applies BOTH decrees' resolve/forbids/onPlayResolved/onCounterResolved/ignoresShield; both healthMults stack at construction. assignDecree -> assignTieredDecree (seeded, tier-pooled, avoids primary repeats). enemyIntent.decrees[] and RoyalView.decrees[] now arrays; combat intent panel + Descent modal render multiple decree pills. 91 vitest (+2 curve tests) + 8 e2e green; tsc/vite build clean. Still at the build gate.

roguelike-expansion P1 (Opponent depth) — user-directed multi-phase plan (P1-P5, Tier-A run structure) informed by a Balatro/Slay-the-Spire research brief. Added ROYAL DECREES: per-royal special rules stored clone-safe as Enemy.decreeId/decreeParam, defined statically in content.DECREE_LIBRARY with fixed hook points (resolve in a new DECREE phase of resolution.ts before JOKERS; forbids veto; onPlayResolved; onCounterResolved; healthMult; ignoresShield; intentNote). Six decrees: Iron Wall (1.5x hp), Headsman (lops a random hand card to discard after each attack), Plague Court (a 2nd suit's power nullified), Vampire King (self-heals half the blow it lands), Executioner (counter ignores shield), Paranoid Crown (no repeating a suit two turns running). Decrees seeded onto royals in run.createRun (first royal stays clean), avoiding immediate repeats. KING ENRAGE: enrageAtPct/enrageAttackBonus -> effectiveAttack() rises below half HP; counterIncoming() folds in enrage + ignoresShield. IMMUNITY ANSWER reintroduced as the 'Usurper's Sigil' relic (cancelsImmunity flag) since the Jester rework removed counterplay. New enemyIntent() selector telegraphs the next strike (incoming, enraged, ignoresShield) + the decree; surfaced in a React combat-overlay banner (intent-strike + decree-pill) under the turn banner, keyboard/colorblind-safe text. previewPlay() now decree-aware and surfaces the forbids veto as invalid (so the action box explains it AND the greedy sim skips forbidden plays instead of soft-looping). Headsman discards (not destroys) to keep deckCount==40. 67 vitest (incl. new decrees.test.ts, +11) + 6 e2e green; tsc/vite build clean. Awaiting review at the P1/P2 phase gate before building P2 (the 'Descent' run-overview modal).
